address: Inn at the Presidio, 42 Moraga Avenue, San Francisco, CA 94129 (Lodge at the Presidio: 105 Montgomery Street, SF 94129)
geo_notes: Pin is the Inn at the Presidio (Pershing Hall, 42 Moraga Ave); Nominatim matched it directly as a hotel POI (37.79707,-122.45785). The Lodge at the Presidio (105 Montgomery St, Main Post barracks) is ~350 m north-east of the Inn. Both addresses confirmed on presidiolodging.com.

notes: Two properties under one operator: Inn at the Presidio (22 rooms, 1903 Pershing Hall, opened 2012) and Lodge at the Presidio (42 rooms, 1890s Montgomery St barracks, opened 2018), plus Funston House (a 4-bedroom 1860s officer's house bookable as a whole). Official site is WordPress and serves 1920x1080 originals directly; a 'Lodge-fire-Pit' image turned out to be a lifestyle shot of guests and was skipped.
